name: Tài Saito
source:
A bookworm through-and-through, Tài is dedicated to her studies for the sake of knowledge. She's been Tom's friend since they were children, and that can sometimes mean that they get on each-other's nerves. She'll always be his friend no matter what even at her own expense. Tài will always put herself second to whatever problems her friends might be having.

Tài is the one that convinced Tom to transfer to Starswirl with her.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
